page_title: MAI 2-0 BOC | Mainz v Bochum 16/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+5' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Karim Onisiwo (Mainz).
90+2' Mainz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+1' Substitution. Jae-Sung Lee did his best and is replaced by Tom Krauss (Mainz).
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) was quite harsh and Matthias Jollenbeck didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
86' The game has begun to heat up. Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
85' The resulting set piece from Bochum is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
84' Matthias Jollenbeck shows a yellow card to Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) for his blatant foul.
82' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
80' Mainz seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
77' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Patrick Osterhage departs the field of play to be replaced by Maximilian Wittek (Bochum).
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) for Lukas Daschner.
74' Felix Passlack (Bochum) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Erhan Masovic.
73' Bo Henriksen has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jessic Ngankam (Mainz) replacing Jonathan Burkardt.
73' The referee signals a substitution. Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) is brought on as a substitute for Ludovic Ajorque.
71' 2 - 0 GOAL! Jae-Sung Lee connects with a delightful cross and heads it towards Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz), whose header goes past Manuel Riemann. 2:0.
71' Mainz have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
67' Takuma Asano (Bochum) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
65' None of the Mainz players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
64' Mainz have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
61' Bo Henriksen has decided to make a change. Josuha Guilavogui (Mainz) replaces Andreas Hanche-Olsen.
61' Substitution. Dominik Kohr makes his way off the pitch and Silvan Widmer (Mainz) comes on as his replacement.
59' The corner is swung in but Bochum can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
57' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Ivan Ordets (Bochum) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
55' A lofted cross from Erhan Masovic (Bochum) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
53' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
51' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
49' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
48' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
48' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) dived to the ground without any contact with the opponent.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Thomas Letsch probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Moritz Broschinski. He is replaced by Philipp Hofmann (Bochum).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+6' The resulting set piece from Mainz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+3' 1 - 0 Goal! Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Manuel Riemann into the bottom left corner.
45+2' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) is going to take the penalty!
45+2' It looks like Bernardo (Bochum) saw red with that tackle. Matthias Jollenbeck won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. The referee gives a penalty to Mainz!
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Mainz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
42' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
39' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
37' The ball is cleared after Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
35' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
33' Bernardo (Bochum) has tested the patience of referee Matthias Jollenbeck and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
31' Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
30' The current number of shots on goal is 0:0.
25' Bernardo (Bochum) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
22' Bochum can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
22' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bochum comes to nothing. Bochum have been awarded a corner kick.
20' Matthias Jollenbeck blows for a foul after Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
18' An attempted cross from Anthony Caci (Mainz) is cleared.
17' Erhan Masovic (Bochum) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
15' The game is interrupted. Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
13' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) sends a cross in and finds Ludovic Ajorque inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
10' Bochum take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
8' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matthias Jollenbeck had an easy-decision to make.
8' Bochum are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
5' The resulting corner from Lukas Daschner (Bochum) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
5' Takuma Asano (Bochum) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Anthony Caci (Mainz).
1' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bochum will have the kick-off.
Matthias Jollenbeck is the one to supervise the game today.
